question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abundant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ample**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abundant"** means existing or available in large quantities; plentiful. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example: **The garden was abundant with flowers in full bloom.
 
 
 
• **"Ample" **refers to enough or more than enough; plentiful. (पर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **There is ample time to complete the assignment.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Abundant' **is **'Ample'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ample**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scarce **(दुर्लभ): Limited in quantity; not enough.

 
 
• **Example:** During the drought, water became scarce.
 
 
 
• **Barren **(बंजर ): Not productive; devoid of life.
 
 
• **Example: **The barren land could not support any crops.
 
 
 
• **Difficult** (कठिन): Needing much effort or skill to accomplish.
 
 
• **Example:** The exam was so difficult that many students failed.
